strat: NA priority / static spreads / OT bait

sources.label: NAUR LesBin - Sextuple Apocalypse - G1 Adjust Static Spreads, Multi-Swap | Safespot Color Apoc version

steps.title: Line up for Dark Water
steps.rule: Supports west, DPS east, two rows each: tanks and melee about 4 m from the centre, healers and ranged further out; MT, H1, M2 and R2 on the north row, OT, H2, M1 and R1 on the south row.

steps.title: Swap for matching Dark Water timers
steps.rule: Compare timers inside your group (no water counts as a timer too). If two supports share one, the first of them in MT > OT > H1 > H2 order trades spots with the first DPS (M1 > M2 > R1 > R2) of the DPS pair that also match; with two pairs each, the shorter timers swap together.

steps.title: Stack for the first Dark Water
steps.rule: Each group stacks about 5 m from the centre, supports west and DPS east, counting any swap, to split the two short Dark Waters.

steps.title: Spread for Spirit Taker
steps.rule: Spread out from your lineup spot (still swapped): tanks and melee about 5 m from the centre, healers and ranged out to 12 m.

steps.title: Swapped players go home
steps.rule: Anyone who swapped goes back to their own side and spot; keep the spread.

steps.title: Static spreads for Dark Eruption
steps.rule: Read the first lit spoke and which way the lights turn, then spread on the line they reach fourth: supports on its west end (north end if it runs north-south), DPS on the other. Healers and ranged at the wall, tanks and melee halfway, the second of them one spoke back toward the first lights.

steps.title: Collapse onto the line
steps.rule: Right after the eruptions, tanks and melee step in to 4 m on the same line; healers and ranged stay out at the wall on it.

steps.title: Stack for the second Dark Water
steps.rule: Both groups stack 4 m from the centre on that line, supports on the west end and DPS on the other, counting any swap.

steps.title: OT baits Darkest Dance
steps.rule: OT: head out on the line one spoke back from the stack line, on your group's end, ready to be the farthest player.

steps.title: Everyone else to the middle
steps.rule: Everyone but the OT gathers in the middle so the OT is clearly the farthest.

steps.title: OT out to the wall
steps.rule: OT: keep going to the wall on that line so Darkest Dance jumps to you.

steps.title: Stack against Gaia
steps.rule: Gaia lands next to the OT: everyone runs to her and stacks tight on her centre side, supports and DPS slightly apart.

steps.title: Split for the last Dark Water
steps.rule: Spread into your two groups either side of Gaia, about 4 m apart on her centre side, ready for the knockback and the last Dark Water stacks.
